GBNEMBA Tuesday Western Greenway Social Ride

Waltham, MA · Mountain bike

No-drop

GBNEMBA Tuesday Western Greenway Social Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Waltham, MA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Mighty Squirrel Brewing Co.. Pace: multiple pace groups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: multiple pace groups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GBNEMBA Tuesday Western Greenway Social Ride group ride

A weekly social trail ride on the Western Greenway, Beaver Brook and Lone Tree Hill network, leaving from a brewery. Several paces, no-drop. The chapter also runs a Monday beginner ride and a Tuesday women and gender-expansive ride with Hustle Hive; check the chapter page for those.
